name: Space Rocket
author: Addicting Games
description: Space Rocket is a free mobile game. Welcome to the final frontier. A world where gravity is a distant memory and the only real rule is speed and the immortal science of reflexes. In this game, you'll take to the stars and beyond while you dodge satellites, avoid asteroids and keep your distance from the alien baddies. In space, no one can hear you win, so, you'll have to announce your victories by screaming into the void or signing up for an account and rocketing up our very own leaderboard. This is a fast-action game where all you have to do is swipe, swoosh, dash, and dodge if you want to make it to the top of the world and beyond. Space Rocket is a fast and furious game that requires a quick hand and a steady eye. If you truly want to succeed in this game you'll have to hunker down and let it go! Space is chaos, a never-ending void that is just waiting to be explored and conquered. As the premeire Space Rocket, it is your job to do the scouting and find a place to land and live.
